name: HyperFrames Media Production
summary: Create and prepare voiceover, music, sound effects, transcription, background-removal and caption assets for HyperFrames.
problem: Audio and media preparation can become inconsistent when providers, timing metadata and asset placement are handled through separate ad hoc workflows.
coreOutcomes: Prepare audio requests and reconcile generated media metadata
Select supported provider or local fallback paths
Prepare transcription, background-removal and caption inputs for compositions
requirements: A HyperFrames project and a defined media need
Provider credentials or the local dependencies required by the selected workflow
boundaries: Provider availability, permissions and output quality are not guaranteed by the skill
Keep credentials outside the public repository and report when an operation is unavailable
